title: Front-End Developer (Angular)
description:
We are looking for a passionate, experienced Senior Front\-End Angular Developer to lead the development of enterprise\-grade web applications. The ideal candidate should have deep expertise in Angular, TypeScript, UI architecture, performance optimisation, and modern front\-end development practices.

While the primary focus is Front\-End development, experience with **.NET Core APIs and backend integration** will be an added advantage.

Key Responsibilities: Front\-End Development (Primary Focus)

* Design, develop, and maintain enterprise\-grade web applications using Angular.
* Build reusable, scalable, and maintainable UI components and modules.
* Develop responsive and mobile\-friendly user interfaces.
* Collaborate closely with UX/UI designers to deliver engaging user experiences.
* Integrate Angular applications with REST APIs and backend systems.
* Optimise application performance, speed, and accessibility.
* Implement state management using NgRx or similar frameworks.
* Ensure cross\-browser compatibility and responsive design standards.
* Write clean, testable, and maintainable code following best practices.

Technical Leadership

* Participate in application architecture and design discussions.
* Lead front\-end development best practices and coding standards.
* Conduct code reviews and mentor junior developers.
* Troubleshoot and resolve production and performance issues.
* Collaborate with Product Owners, QA Teams, Business Analysts, and Backend Developers.

Backend Integration (Preferred)

* Work with .NET Core APIs and microservices.
* Collaborate with backend teams for API design and integration.
* Understand authentication and authorization mechanisms such as JWT and OAuth.

Required Technical SkillsAngular (Must Have)

* 6\+ years of Front\-End development experience.
* 4\+ years of hands\-on experience with Angular (v14\+ preferred).
* Strong expertise in:
* Angular Components
* Services
* Modules
* Directives
* Pipes
* Dependency Injection
* Routing
* Lazy Loading
* Reactive Forms
* Strong understanding of Angular Architecture and Design Patterns.
* Experience with Angular Material, PrimeNG, or Bootstrap.
* Knowledge of Angular Signals and modern Angular features is highly preferred.

Web Technologies

* TypeScript
* JavaScript (ES6\+)
* HTML5
* CSS3
* SCSS/SASS
* Responsive Web Design
* Progressive Web Applications (PWAs)

State Management

* NgRx
* RxJS
* Observables
* Reactive Programming

API Integration

* RESTful APIs
* JSON Data Handling
* JWT Authentication
* OAuth2 / SSO Integration

Testing

* Jasmine
* Karma
* Cypress
* Unit and Integration Testing

Tools \& DevOps

* Git
* Azure DevOps
* GitHub/GitLab
* CI/CD Pipelines
* Agile/Scrum Methodologies

Preferred Skills

* .NET Core and Web API understanding.
* Micro Frontend Architecture.
* Azure Cloud Services.
* Docker and Containerization.
* SignalR integration.
* Accessibility (WCAG) compliance.
* Performance tuning for large\-scale applications.
* Enterprise SaaS application development experience.

Educational Qualifications

* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* Angular or Microsoft certifications will be an advantage.

Experience Requirements

* Minimum 6\+ years of software development experience.
* Minimum 4\+ years of dedicated Angular development experience.
* Experience working on complex enterprise web applications.
* Experience mentoring developers and leading front\-end initiatives.
* Strong understanding of modern UI/UX principles and best practices.

Soft Skills

* Excellent communication and presentation skills.
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical thinking.
* Ability to work independently and within cross\-functional teams.
* Strong ownership and accountability.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.

What We Offer

* Opportunity to lead front\-end development for enterprise products.
* Exposure to cutting\-edge Angular technologies.
* Collaborative and innovation\-driven work environment.
* Career growth into Technical Lead and Architecture roles.
* Competitive compensation and benefits.

Key Hiring CriteriaMust Have

✅ Angular 14\+ / Latest Versions  
✅ TypeScript, RxJS, NgRx  
✅ Angular Material / PrimeNG  
✅ Responsive UI Development  
✅ REST API Integration  
✅ Enterprise Web Application Experience  
✅ 6\+ Years Overall Experience

Good to Have

✅ .NET Core APIs  
✅ Azure Cloud  
✅ Micro Frontends  
✅ Docker  
✅ SignalR

**Interested candidates can send their updated resume with the subject line: "Application for Senior Front\-End Angular Developer" to the HR Team at Maxus Technologies Pvt. Ltd.**

Pay: ₹350,000\.00 \- ₹1,000,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: React Developer – Fresher Program
description:
**Fresher to Full\-Time Opportunity**

We're looking for passionate and self\-motivated **React Developers** who are eager to learn, build, and grow while working on real\-world products. You'll work alongside experienced developers to build modern, responsive web applications using React and related frontend technologies.

This opportunity is open to **final\-year students, fresh graduates, or candidates with up to 1 year of experience**.

Responsibilities

* Develop responsive and interactive web applications using **React.js**, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
* Convert UI/UX designs into pixel\-perfect, responsive user interfaces.
* Build reusable React components and maintain clean, scalable code.
* Integrate frontend applications with REST APIs.
* Debug, test, and optimize applications for performance.
* Collaborate with designers, backend developers, and QA teams.

Tech Stack You'll Work With

* React.js
* JavaScript (ES6\+)
* HTML5
* CSS3
* Bootstrap / Tailwind CSS
* REST APIs
* Git

Requirements

* Good understanding of React.js, JavaScript (ES6\+), HTML5, and CSS3\.
* Familiarity with React Hooks, Components, Props, State Management, and API integration.
* Ability to build responsive and user\-friendly web interfaces.
* Understanding of responsive design principles.
* Basic knowledge of Git and version control.
* Good problem\-solving and debugging skills.
* Good verbal and written communication skills.
* Bachelor's degree (or pursuing final year) in Computer Science or a related field.
* Portfolio, GitHub, or personal React projects will be an added advantage.

What You'll Gain

* Hands\-on experience working on live products.
* Mentorship from experienced developers.
* Exposure to modern frontend architecture and development practices.
* Opportunity to build production\-ready applications.
* Performance\-based Letter of Recommendation.
* Opportunity to transition into a full\-time React Developer role based on performance.

Fresher to Full\-Time Opportunity

* **First 3\-6 Months:** ₹5,000/month \+ Conveyance Allowance up to ₹1,500/month.
* **Post 3\-6 Months:** Performance\-based opportunity to transition into a **Full\-Time React Developer** role with a salary of **₹10,000/month \+ ₹1,500/month Conveyance Allowance**.

Pay: ₹6,500\.00 per month

Application Question(s):

* Please provide your LinkedIn profile URL. If you do not have one, you may write “N/A.”
* Do you know React?
* We must fill this position urgently. Can you start immediately?
* Have you made any projects using React?
* Will you be available to work from 10 AM to 7 PM, Monday to Friday?
* Are you comfortable commuting to this job's location in Matunga West (5\-minute walking distance from Matunga Road railway station and 10\-minute walking distance from Matunga Central railway station)?
* Do you acknowledge that you will receive ₹5,000 \+ Conveyance Allowance up to ₹1,500 per month for the first 3\-6 months, followed by a performance\-based full\-time opportunity with a salary of ₹10,000 \+ ₹1,500 Conveyance Allowance?

Work Location: In person
